name: Country Snacks Manufacturing
description: Country Snacks Manufacturing, operating as Carolina Country Snacks, is a snack food producer in Henderson, North Carolina. The company cooks pork rinds and pork skins each day and also makes popcorn cracklins and pork rind strips, which are processed for a crunchier texture than traditional puffed rinds. Products include Old Time Fatback Skins and sweet and mild BBQ cracklins. The company describes its products as low carbohydrate, with under 1% carbs. Snacks are sold online in cases of 12 or 24 bags of 1.75 ounces each.

name: Cox Brothers Food Equipment Repair
description: Cox Brothers has been in business serving restaurants, grocery stores and convenience stores in Mid-Missouri since 2002. Our techs are skilled at repairing Commercial Refrigeration equipment, ice machines, coffee, soda, beverage systems and any type of gas or electric food equipment. Our highest priorities are fast and dependable service. We work hard to be easy to contact any time you need us. We care about helping our customers make good decisions about keeping their equipment running reliably. When your equipment breaks down we do the best we can to recommend your best course of action, whether repair or replacement is the best choice. We offer scheduled maintenance plans in addition to speedy service!
